surprises.head: Carolina controlled the chances
surprises.body: Expected goals ran 5.1 to 2.2 for Carolina, with empty nets left out.

surprises.head: Vancouver shot far less than usual
surprises.body: 30.1 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5, adjusted for score and venue, against its usual 45.7.

surprises.head: Vancouver tried a different line
surprises.body: B. Boeser, M. Rossi, P. Cotter played 6:46 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of Vancouver’s usual lines.
